name: pm-skills
description: Structured AI workflows for Head-of-Product work: 34 domain-specific skills and 9 chained workflows across 3 plugins — ERP/retail/inventory domain intelligence, enterprise requirements rigor, and Head-of-Product leadership.

plugins.name: pm-erp-domain
plugins.description: ERP, retail, and inventory domain intelligence for PMs: stock logic, warehouse workflows, transfers, allocation, procurement, accounting consistency, RBAC, audit trails, and reconciliation for ERP/retail/warehouse systems.

plugins.name: pm-requirements-plus
plugins.description: Requirements and delivery rigor for PMs building on complex/enterprise systems: business process modeling, business rules, technical impact analysis, security review, QA test-scenario generation, and release go/no-go gating.

plugins.name: pm-leadership
plugins.description: Head-of-Product leadership workflows: a copilot that routes broad questions to the right specialist skill, weekly digests, 1:1 prep, board updates, hiring briefs, decision memos, and product-health rollups.
